verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs explicitly state individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time (github-copilot-docs-12), directly satisfying the story's core ask. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on how opt-out is enforced, whether it covers all Copilot data flows (e.g., telemetry, code review, agents), and community commentary voices skepticism (not concrete contradiction) about whether enterprise code can truly be excluded. Missing for 10: independent verification that opt-out is honored in practice, clarity on enterprise/org-level data-use guarantees, and details on scope of what 'training' opt-out actually excludes.
